title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1989-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90)

ai_review.summary: Good matrix recording of a high‑energy show packed with standout performances like Bertha > Good Lovin’, Masterpiece, Terrapin Station and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The concert captures the band at a peak of energy with solid song choices and memorable moments—from the opening Bertha > Good Lovin’ to a trippy Other One and an extended Terrapin Station. Reviewers praise the overall flow and the band's communication, while noting only minor lyric flubs. The UltraMatrix source delivers a clear enough mix that doesn’t detract from the enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed positive review highlights many standout songs and strong performance, suggesting a high show rating; recording is described as an UltraMatrix source with no complaints, leading to a good but not exceptional recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; UltraMatrix generally provides a balanced mix of board and audience sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Review emphasizes a consistently high energy throughout both sets, with smooth transitions (e.g., Jack Straw > China > Rider) and a climactic close that left the crowd ecstatic.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (referred to as 'Bobby') leads the way on Masterpiece, drawing specific praise.
